# Security Policy / 安全策略

Do not publish exploitable vulnerabilities, injected private prompts, credentials, or personal file paths in a public issue.

请勿在公开 Issue 中发布可利用漏洞、私人角色提示词、凭据或个人文件路径。

Use a [private GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/liangbannianikun-cmd/kira-switch/security/advisories/new) and include the affected version, target client, reproduction steps, and expected impact. Replace all real character data and credentials with test values.

请通过 [GitHub 私有安全报告](https://github.com/liangbannianikun-cmd/kira-switch/security/advisories/new) 提交受影响版本、目标客户端、复现步骤和影响范围，并将真实角色数据与凭据替换为测试值。
